annotations.category_path: Military Retirement / Components of the Military Retirement Program / Adjustment for Payday Shifta
annotations.variable_note: Section 632 of the Ike Skelton National Defense Authorization Act for Fiscal Year 2011 (Public Law 111-383) requires the Department of Defense to make retirement payments on the first day of each month. If the first day of the month occurs on a holiday or a weekend, payments are instead made on the preceding business day. That will result in one additional paycheck in fiscal years 2022 and 2028 and one fewer paycheck in fiscal years 2024 and 2029. Section 632 does not affect the timing of survivor benefit payments.
